mapper.insert: INSERT INTO search_sync_state (task_type, biz_key, requested_version, updated_at) VALUES (#{type}, #{key}, 1, UTC_TIMESTAMP(6)) ON DUPLICATE KEY UPDATE requested_version = requested_version + 1, updated_at = UTC_TIMESTAMP(6)
mapper.select: SELECT biz_key, requested_version, published_version FROM search_sync_state WHERE task_type=#{type} AND biz_key=#{key}
SELECT biz_key, requested_version, published_version FROM search_sync_state WHERE task_type=#{type} AND biz_key IN #{key}
mapper.sql: EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM business_task t WHERE t.task_id=#{taskId} AND t.lease_owner=#{owner} AND t.status='RUNNING' AND t.lease_until > UTC_TIMESTAMP(6))
mapper.update: UPDATE search_sync_state SET running_task_id=NULL, running_lease_owner=NULL WHERE task_type=#{type} AND biz_key=#{key} AND running_task_id=#{taskId} AND running_lease_owner=#{owner}
mapper.select: SELECT product_id FROM product_info WHERE product_id > #{cursor} ORDER BY product_id LIMIT #{limit}
SELECT question_id FROM rag_question WHERE question_id > #{cursor} ORDER BY question_id LIMIT #{limit}
SELECT CAST(question_id AS CHAR) FROM rag_question WHERE question_id IN #{key}
